caption_L1: This is a bar plot labeled Rate of coronavirus (COVID-19) tests performed in selected countries between April 1st and November 25 , 2020 (per 100,000 population). There is a categorical scale starting with Brazil and ending with United States on the y-axis, marked Country. Along the x-axis, July 26, 2020 is shown with a linear scale with a minimum of 0 and a maximum of 15,000.
caption_L2L3: Iran, The Netherlands, and France performed the least COVID tests in this timeframe. They all performed less than 5,000 per 100,000 population. The United Kingdom, followed by the United States performed the most. Both countries performed over 15,000 per 100,000 population.
